museum_original_name: Museo Egizio (Fondazione Museo delle Antichità Egizie di Torino)
stated_count: 15 catalogue entries of crocodile mummies/parts (cat. Nos. 149-163) in the 2024 animal-mummy catalogue; 13 of them online
stated_count_source: Ikram, Aicardi, Facchetti (eds.), The Animal Mummies of the Museo Egizio, Turin, 2024, ch. 8.12, pp. 334-351
possible_additional_holdings: Historic Drovetti inventory (Documenti inediti III, 1880, pp. 260-261) lists '1. Crocodile embaumé' and '79. Crocodile embaumé, au quel il manque la queue' - identification with current objects ongoing (Moiso and Montonati, RiME, forthcoming), per Ikram et al. 2024. Online DB covers only >4,000 of c. 40,000 objects.
scholarly_catalogue: Ikram, Aicardi, Facchetti (eds.), The Animal Mummies of the Museo Egizio, Turin (Studi del Museo Egizio 5), 2024
image_license: CC0 Public Domain (site meta: 'Le immagini sono liberamente scaricabili e riutilizzabili con licenza Creative Commons CC0 Public Domain')
notes: Search results embedded as JSON ('listaRisultati') in the HTML search page - no public API found. Online inventory numbers differ in format from catalogue (e.g. online 'Provv. 1458/n.12' = catalogue 'Provv. 1458/3 (other number: 12)'; online 'Cat. 2353/10' = catalogue 'Cat. 2353/1 (other number: 10)'). Images flagged 'Contenuto potenzialmente sensibile'.

museum: Museo Civico di Modena (Museo Civico Archeologico Etnologico)
museum_original_name: Museo Civico di Modena - Museo Civico Archeologico Etnologico
stated_count_source: Museo Civico di Modena, teachers' dossier 'Storie d'Egitto. La riscoperta della raccolta egiziana del Museo Civico' (PDF, exhibition 16 Feb 2018 [sic] - 7 Jun 2020); Comune di Modena press releases 2019
possible_additional_holdings: PatER (Emilia-Romagna regional catalogue) has at least one individual card 'mummia/ coccodrillo, Museo Civico Archeologico Etnologico, età greco-romana' (id_card=229798) - found only via search engine, site returns 403 so not opened; search snippets say one specimen still wrapped in original coarse strip. Another PatER card (id_card=229629, 'Dettaglio Scheda RA') snippet mentions a crocodile skull with plant-fibre cord - holding institution unverified.
scholarly_catalogue: UNKNOWN (Museo Egizio library lists 'La storia della collezione egizia del Museo Archeologico Civico di Modena' - not consulted)
notes: Official PDF: Pietro Tacchini (astronomer, in Egypt 1882 for eclipse observed at Sohag) received from Licurgo Santoni (director of Posts of Egypt and Nubia) a mummy head and three small embalmed crocodiles, donated to the Museum of Modena. 'I tre piccoli coccodrilli provengono da una località vicina ad Assiut, il villaggio di el-Maabda sulla riva est del Nilo'. PDF includes a photo captioned 'I tre piccoli coccodrilli donati a Pietro Tacchini da Licurgo Santoni'. No individual object rows written (no inventory numbers accessible; PatER blocked).

possible_additional_holdings: Same Panceri 1873-74 expedition was run with Museo Civico di Storia Naturale di Milano - Milan may have received El-Maabdeh crocodiles too (lead)
notes: Live official site cmsnf.it returned 520 (curl) and 401 (WebFetch) on 2026-09-24; text read from Wayback Machine snapshot (2022). museum: Museo Archeologico Nazionale di Firenze (Museo Egizio di Firenze)

stated_count: 12 crocodile mummies (Tezzele 2014 Cat. 15-26) among 65 animal mummies
stated_count_source: Tezzele 2014 (Univ. Pisa MA thesis); 65 animal mummies also stated on MAF official blog 2018
possible_additional_holdings: None known beyond the 12; Cat. 12 (inv. 4744, unidentified mummy end) thought cat/dog
scholarly_catalogue: Tezzele 2014; Schiaparelli 1887 (Catalogo generale ... antichità egizie); Del Francia and Guidotti 1993 (Strozzi Sacrati collection)
notes: No online collection DB for the Egyptian section found; national ICCD catalogue has no crocodile mummy records. Crocodiles from Rosellini (Franco-Tuscan expedition 1828-29), Ricci collection (1832) and Strozzi Sacrati collection (1992). Official museum site museoarcheologiconazionaledifirenze.it not checked for further records.
